newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hai Sun Hup details expansion plans.
newsitem.headline: Hai Sun Hup details expansion plans.

text.p: Shipping-based Hai Sun Hup Group Ltd (HSH) on Monday gave details on how it plans to use funds raised from its proposed US$100 million transferable loan facility.
In its circular to shareholders on the issue, HSH said the net proceeds of the issue after expenses will be about US$99 million of which US$39 million will be used to refinance bank borrowings.
About US$53 million will be for the investment and development of two properties in Australia, the Caltex House in Sydney and the St. George in Perth.
About US$7 million will be used to acquire new vessels and the balance will be used for working capital.
